pullRequests.title: fix(carry): name the release's empty level hooks by their callers
pullRequests.author: nickyyOO
pullRequests.head: fix/hook-names-by-callers
pullRequests.body:
Before: the boot's empty 8-byte level hooks were paired with v1.01's by order. USA v2.00 has its hooks 8 bytes on and one more, and PAL has its own run, so many release hooks had another hook's name (func_0026F748, the hero's state change hook, among them). OpenRAC had to pair them again by their callers (pair_stubs).

pullRequests.title: fix(L06): call FastVecAdd in path_update_attached_point_table
pullRequests.author: nickyyOO
pullRequests.head: fix/taxi-points-vec-add
pullRequests.body:
Before: path_update_attached_point_table called func_2EEEB8, a name copied from level 17. It is FastVecAdd only there. The decomp still matched (the build reads the jal), but OpenRAC read the name as level 0's function at that address (quaternion_to_rotation_basis). On Boldan the taxi then wrote matrices over the path table, and the rail ships crashed the game when the hero went down the lift.

commits.headline: fix(L06): call FastVecAdd in path_update_attached_point_table (#468)
commits.author: nickyyOO
commits.body:
func_2EEEB8 is FastVecAdd only in level 17. In the levels that carry this
function (6, 9, 11, 13, 18) the retail jal goes to each level's own
FastVecAdd copy, and OpenRAC read the name as level 0's function at
0x2EEEB8 (quaternion_to_rotation_basis), which overwrote path data on
Boldan's taxi.
